blue   <- "#2a78d6"   # main colour for single-series plots
orange <- "#eb6834"   # second, contrasting category
grey   <- "#d8d8d4"   # background / "nothing to see here"
red    <- "#e34948"   # errors and things to worry about

dim(BEW)

--- 1a. Which variables contain only NA values? -----------------------------
```{r}
all_missing1 <- sapply(BEA, function(x) all(is.na(x)))

names(BEA)[all_missing1]

all_missing2 <- sapply(BEA, function(x) all(is.na(x)))

names(BEA)[all_missing2]
```

```{r}
sum(all_missing1)
sum(all_missing2)
```

ANSWER: No variables is completely empty

--- A column that is empty but does not LOOK empty --------------------------
```{r}
table(BEA$host_verifications, useNA = "ifany")
table(BEW$host_verifications, useNA = "ifany")
```
